biocontainers.name: bioconductor-treeandleaf
biocontainers.summary: An alternative to dendrogram visualization and insertion of multiple layers of information

biotools.summary: TreeAndLeaf implements a hybrid layout strategy that enhances leaf-level visualization in dendrograms. By integrating force-directed graph and tree layout algorithms, it enables projection of multiple layers of information onto graph–tree diagrams.
